method_rule: one equal vote per complete canonical caller pair; partial and missing calls do not vote; maximum pair support wins; exact top ties are resolved lexicographically; no complete pair yields no_evidence
partial_call_rule: retain one resolvable allele with call_status partial; never infer homozygosity from a missing second allele
superiority_screen: paired subject-cluster sign-flip tests with Holm correction within modality

noninferiority.interval: Bonferroni-simultaneous subject-cluster bootstrap upper bounds within modality

truth_firewall: truth-free prediction, immutable checksum freeze, and one-time join
three_modality_claim_rule: all modalities valid; prospective design; sample minima met; WGS audit passed; no comparator Holm-superior; plurality noninferior within two points to every frozen deployable comparator
claim_boundary: research-only HLA-A/B/C typing in evaluated WGS, WES, and bulk RNA-seq designs; plurality is not a novel algorithm or a universal NGS optimum
